title: Validator/PayoutRules contract drift: payoutTable length must be exactly 4 for competitive definitions
description: [RE-CREATED after working-tree cleaning deleted the untracked original] Found by rev-c037 during the TASK-037 review (MEDIUM-1): MicrogameDefinitionValidator.ValidatePayoutTable (Content/MicrogameDefinitionValidator.cs:78-95, TASK-030) accepts any payoutTable of length >= 1, while the new PayoutRules.ApplyCompetitive (Scoring/PayoutRules.cs:66-67, TASK-037) throws ArgumentException unless length == 4. A v2 definition with payoutTable [6,4,2] passes validation GREEN and then crashes at scoring time — loud, but mid-session on a bar cabinet, exactly what the validator exists to prevent. Fix direction (GDD-canonical, §6.1 tables are 4-place): the validator should require exactly 4 entries for competitive-mode definitions (red test in the validator suite first); alternatively (weaker) PayoutRules documents and accepts N >= max place. Coop-mode tables have their own shape — do not break the coop path. Touches the closed TASK-030 surface: normal tdd flow, no open review on it.
acceptance_criteria: A red validator-suite test pins that a competitive definition with payoutTable length != 4 fails validation with a field-naming error, committed strictly before the fix
Validator and PayoutRules agree on the contract (no input can validate green and then throw in PayoutRules); coop payout shape unaffected

comments.author: developer
comments.body: Delivered tests-first on master by dev-t101: 6d22b07 test(core) red — 12 GENUINE assertion failures against the no-length-check validator (all three dynamics + a direct cross-check test) -> d652d73 fix(core). Suite 518 -> 530/530. DESIGN CALL (flagged): GDD 6.1 describes two payout shapes under the same field — competitive 4-entry (one per place) vs coop 2-entry ([success, fail], confirmed against PayoutRules.ApplyCoop's signature and the pre-existing 2-element coop test). Asym1v3 has NO separate GDD-described payout shape and TASK-035's RoundRecord.Places uses ranked 1..4 for every dynamics, so asym1v3 requires 4 entries too (not just literal Dynamics.Competitive) — flagged in case 'competitive-mode' in the AC meant something narrower. Implementation: ValidatePayoutTable now takes MicrogameDynamics, checks Length against 4 (competitive/asym1v3) or 2 (coop) BEFORE the per-entry minimum-payout check, failing loudly with field name + actual vs required length. AC2 anti-drift sensor: PayoutTable_LengthContractMatchesPayoutRules_NoValidatedInputEverThrows sweeps lengths 0-6 across all three dynamics asserting validate-green implies apply-never-throws — catches FUTURE drift, not just the [6,4,2] case. Coop path unchanged (both pre-existing coop tests pass untouched).
